correctness.rationale: The six centers have l1 norm 3/2 and all 15 differences are outside int P. A separate exact Fraction-based reconstruction built the 24 vertices, six square and eight hexagonal facets, then recursively triangulated the complete boundary and found 438 covered leaves at maximum depth 3 with strict minimum inequality slack 1/16. Finite facet subdivision, certified using convexity, covers the continuous boundary exactly; via the central-symmetry boundary-cover criterion P+2z_i is a touching pairwise interior-disjoint blocking family. No lower bound b(P)>=6 is established.
